_comment: The vendored English runtime was translated by find-and-replace and the pass was never finished: 'Potenza' became 'Power' and the rest of the sentence stayed Italian. Each broken string here is mapped onto the English it should have had. The correct English becomes the catalog key, and both the Italian build and the broken English build map onto it — so English is repaired by the same mechanism that serves every other language. Regenerated files must not be edited instead: the runtime is vendored and comes back on the next sync.
